company.shortDescription: Bitaccess Inc is a Canadian Fintech startup focusing on Blockchain technologies.
company.description:
Founded in November 2013, Bitaccess is a privately held technology company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. From start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, Bitaccess provides software services to power Fintech businesses in over 15 countries. Our customers rely on Bitaccess software and services to power their core infrastructure, compliance, security and support services.

Bitaccess’ mission is to provide every person and business with access to public blockchain technology. We promise to develop technologies that are secure, accessible and easy-to-use

aiResearchSummary.text: Bitaccess is researching and developing systems and methods for facilitating in-person payments at a transaction kiosk, as described in Blockchain-based transaction kiosk. Their work involves providing an authentication interface at a network-enabled transaction kiosk, authenticating users, and enabling blockchain-based transactions. This research and development focuses on secure, user-authenticated blockchain payment solutions at physical kiosks.
